Name: Bachelorettes and Divorcees
Author: PepGames
Description:
This mod is a very very early ALPHA. 

Hi I'm SuperPep,

You ever think it's annoying how you can't romance all the npc's in the game? Me too. This mod makes all of those NPC's single. Currently this is more of a proof of concept rather than a fleshed out experience. All this mod does right now is make these NPC's considered "single" in the game logic. 

[u]Now Single:[/u]
Jodi
Caroline
Robin
Evelyn
Pam
Marnie

If you have mod config menu installed you can toggle their single status on or off via the settings.

So anyway I made this mod, it's my first mod so I honestly don't know what I'm doing. The ultimate goal of this mod would be to include support for other characters and possible ones from other mods such as SVE, East Scarp, etc. If anyone has advice please reach out!

For those wondering, apparently Polyamory Sweet allows the player to romance all villagers using the[code]"RomanceAllVillagers"[/code]option in the config. This feature allows any villager to be married which I believe my mod does NOT provide currently. We are working out the kinks.

Manifest.Name: Bachelorettes and Divorcés
Manifest.Description: Makes all women who would otherwise not be datable, single and romanceable.
Manifest.Author: PepGames
